metadata.description: Sourced agent skills for building and stocking closed glass habitats

plugins.name: vivarium-expert
plugins.description: Design, build, stock, and troubleshoot paludariums, vivariums, terrariums, and aquariums. Covers structural glass, silicone, bracing, floor loading, climate and condensation, PPFD/PAR/UVB lighting, waterfalls and filtration, plant selection, animal compatibility, and bioactive clean-up crews. Every load-bearing number carries a source URL; gaps are marked UNVERIFIED rather than guessed.
